name: Zep
description: Retrieve temporal graph memory and authorized business context.

methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in with the work identity configured for your Zep project's Memory MCP server. Zep restricts access to that identity's memory and authorized shared graphs.
methods.label: Sign in with Zep
warnings: A Zep project with Memory MCP enabled, available MCP seats, and Google Workspace or enterprise OIDC configured by its administrator. Project API keys do not authenticate Memory MCP.
